_doc: Who-replaces-whom RB reallocation (statline_model.apply_rb_replacement). When an RB/WR/TE with real usage (played the team's previous game; trailing carry share >= .20 or target share >= .12) is OUT/DOUBTFUL and the biggest vacater of a channel is an RB, each remaining RB gets frac[rank] x vacated share x team trailing volume added to that channel's mean (rank = depth by trailing share among active RBs; rank 4+ uses rank 3). Fit leave-one-season-out on 2016-25 nflverse usage (no FC data); analysis/who_replaces_whom. Off: DFS_WRW_RB=0.
_scale_doc: Shrink on the added points, fit on real-pipeline current-code rebuilds of 72 DK main slates 2021-25 (LOSO k .57-.74, all-data .68). Unscaled the pipeline overshoots (bias -1.1) because price-anchored volume already carries part of the bump.
